title: The 8 Best Hand Saws for Woodworking 2026
h1: The 8 Best Hand Saws for Woodworking 2026
metaDescription: Our 8 picks for hand saws for woodworking 2026, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at hand saws for woodworking 2026 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Gyokucho Razorsaw 9-1/2-Inch Double Edge (Ryoba) for Hardwoods
products.blurb: Key specs: Pull-stroke cutting, Dual-edge (rip and crosscut), Thin kerf.
strengths: Pull-stroke design cuts on the pull stroke, which is the natural direction of wrist and arm movement
Dual-edge design: crosscut teeth on one side, rip teeth on the other
Thin kerf removes less material and requires less force than Western-style push saws
Japanese pull saw teeth are fleam-filed for the cleanest possible cut surface
limitations: Replacement blades are required rather than resharpening -- a recurring cost
Dual edge means the back edge teeth can damage the bench or the finished surface
products.bestFor: buyers who want the best overall package

products.name: Gyokucho Razorsaw Kataba Saw 240mm No. 410
products.blurb: Key specs: Premium Japanese single-edge saw, Precision-filed crosscut teeth, No back-edge tooth hazard.
strengths: Gyokucho is one of the highest-quality Japanese saw brands widely available outside Japan
Precision impulse-hardened teeth stay sharp longer than standard hand-filed teeth
Single-edge design eliminates the back-edge tooth hazard of a dual-edge ryoba
The reference recommendation from experienced hand tool woodworkers for flush and single-direction cuts
limitations: Single edge means a separate saw is needed for the other cutting direction
Replacement blades are a recurring cost since the impulse-hardened teeth can't be resharpened

products.name: Stanley 15-579 15-Inch SharpTooth Saw
products.blurb: Key specs: Push-stroke Western design, Triple-cut teeth, Comfortable handle.
strengths: Western-style push saw for woodworkers who prefer the familiar push-stroke action
Triple-cut teeth cut faster and stay sharp longer than traditional hand-filed teeth
15-inch blade handles large crosscuts and furniture parts
The most affordable quality crosscut saw -- outperforms every older Western saw for the price
limitations: Non-sharpenable teeth -- replace the saw when dull
Produces slightly more tearout than Japanese pull saws in fine woodworking

products.name: Spear & Jackson Professional Tenon Saw, 10-Inch x 13 PPI
products.blurb: Key specs: Brass back reinforced, Precision filed teeth, For joinery.
strengths: Spear & Jackson has manufactured British hand saws to a professional standard since 1760
Brass back keeps the blade perfectly straight during precision joinery cuts
Hand-filed teeth produce a clean cut in hardwood tenon cheeks and shoulders
A traditional backsaw that will outlast most budget saws with basic care
limitations: Higher price than a basic hardware-store backsaw
Specialized for precision joinery -- not appropriate for general rough crosscutting

products.name: Gyokucho Japanese Pull Saw, Dozuki Style, 180mm Blade
products.blurb: Key specs: Single-edge design, No back edge hazard, Crosscut teeth.
strengths: Single-edge design eliminates the back-edge tooth hazard of dual-edge saws
Correct for flush-cutting (cutting protruding tenons, dowels, and plugs flush with the surface)
Gyokucho quality tooth geometry in a single-edge format
The paired companion to a dual-edge pull saw for workpiece surface protection
limitations: Single edge means changing saws between rip and crosscut cuts

products.name: Gyokucho Razorsaw Kataba Saw 255mm No. 105
products.blurb: Key specs: Single-edge, longer blade, Natural wrapped handle, Rip and crosscut options.
strengths: Gyokucho produces some of the most widely used Japanese pull saws outside Japan
255mm blade reaches across wider tenon shoulders and larger flush-cut surfaces than the 240mm Kataba
Traditional wrapped handle is comfortable for extended precision work
The correct saw for woodworkers who need single-edge reach beyond the standard Kataba length
limitations: Larger size is less convenient for tight spaces than the shorter Kataba
Impulse-hardened teeth cannot be resharpened -- replace the blade when dull
features: For larger flush-cut and tenon work

products.name: Irwin Marathon 2011201 15-Inch Coarse Cut Carpenter Saw
products.blurb: Key specs: Coarse teeth, Fast rough cutting, Softwood and green wood.
strengths: Coarse teeth cut green wood, pressure-treated lumber, and rough timber faster than fine-tooth saws
Lowest price for a functional 15-inch hand saw
Hardened teeth last through reasonable use before replacement
The correct saw for rough cutting, construction lumber, and material preparation
limitations: Coarse cut produces a rough surface -- not appropriate for joinery or fine woodworking

products.name: Gyokucho 770-3500 Razor Dozuki Saw
products.blurb: Key specs: Back-reinforced blade, Fine crosscut teeth, For precision joinery.
strengths: Dozuki style: reinforced back keeps the blade perfectly straight during precision cuts
Fine crosscut teeth produce the cleanest cut of any hand saw
The Japanese equivalent of a Western backsaw -- used for dovetails and joinery
Gyokucho precision and impulse hardening in the finest-tooth saw category
limitations: Back reinforcement limits depth of cut
Fine teeth are slow in thick or coarse stock

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
